source: Yamaichi Electronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 52,698 million (+16.3% year on year), operating income JPY 11,556 million (+40.5%), ordinary income JPY 12,126 million (+57.7%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 9,073 million (+73.1%); the company says it achieved the 4th Medium-Term Management Plan goal of exceeding net sales of JPY 50 billion and operating income of JPY 10 billion in the final year (year ending March 2026). Segments: Test Solution net sales JPY 26,424 million (+5.2%), operating income JPY 7,009 million (-1.4%); Connector Solution net sales JPY 24,742 million (+30.6%), operating income JPY 4,406 million (+263.2%), both record highs for the segment; Optical-related net sales JPY 1,531 million (+23.9%), operating income JPY 206 million (prior year an operating loss of JPY 25 million).

quarterly_data.quarter: Yamaichi Electronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Management's analysis of FY2026 (annual securities report): in the electronic components market, semiconductors and data centers were strong on robust AI-related investment, industrial equipment recovered as inventory adjustment progressed, and automotive stayed weak on low demand and tariff uncertainty. Test Solution: test sockets for the mainstay smartphones and PCs, plus automotive and wearables, sold well; burn-in sockets were hit by postponed investment, mainly in products for automotive logic semiconductors, while products for memory semiconductors recovered as investment resumed in the second half; soaring gold and copper prices weighed on profit. Connector Solution: telecom products were strong on backbone telecom equipment and a significant increase in products for data centers including AI; industrial products recovered gradually as European customers' inventory adjustment bottomed; automotive products were weak on low global demand and the EV slowdown. Optical-related: orders were recovering overall and products for the telecom market performed well.

quarterly_data.signal: 5th Medium-Term Management Plan (annual securities report): for the plan covering the fiscal years ending March 2027 to March 2029, the company targets net sales of JPY 195.0 billion, operating income of JPY 42.0 billion, an operating margin of 21.5% and profit of JPY 29.5 billion (the report does not say whether these are final-year or three-year totals), with ROE of 18% or more maintained stably; it plans JPY 18.0 billion of capex over the three years for new-product development for AI servers, data centers, automotive and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, plus strengthening production sites, supply capacity expansion and efficiency. Management expects demand for high-reliability, high-performance connection components and high-function optical materials to grow over the medium to long term, driven by AI / data-center investment, more capable mobile devices, vehicle electrification and intelligence, and advances in industrial and medical equipment.

quarterly_data.signal: Business strategy under the 5th Medium-Term Management Plan (annual securities report): Test Solution will extend its mainstay SLT sockets from smartphones and PCs into automotive, wearables and networking, develop high-frequency, high-pin-count, fine-pitch and high-durability technology, and strengthen development and sales of burn-in sockets for automotive ADAS / ADS, AI servers and data centers, expanding in-house integrated production. Connector Solution will strengthen solutions for hyperscale data centers and expand internal-interconnect solutions for next-generation high-speed transmission, launch more global-niche products for semiconductor test and manufacturing equipment, and in automotive expand next-generation camera-module products for ADAS sensing, high-speed transmission products, EV charging and high-current powertrain products. Optical-related will expand production capacity for Blue Glass UVIR-cut products for smartphones and push sales of AR-coat products for data centers and polyimide filters for optical lines.
quarterly_data.quarter: Yamaichi Electronics annual securities report: FY2026 (06-24-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Capex, FY2026 (annual securities report): JPY 3,384,494 thousand (108.3% of the prior year) - Test Solution JPY 1,152,067 thousand (63.0%), Connector Solution JPY 1,009,818 thousand (130.7%), Optical-related JPY 28,045 thousand, corporate / eliminations JPY 1,194,563 thousand. Planned new facilities as of March 31, 2026: production equipment for Test Solution and Connector Solution at the Sakura plant (Chiba) JPY 2,842,194 thousand, at Pricon Microelectronics (Laguna, Philippines) JPY 182,320 thousand and at Yamaichi Electronics Deutschland (Aschheim-Dornach, Germany) JPY 155,765 thousand, and Test Solution equipment at the Korean subsidiary (Eumseong, Chungbuk) JPY 137,130 thousand - all April 2026 to March 2027 - and a next-generation core IT system at head office JPY 1,886,000 thousand (JPY 1,222,615 thousand paid; November 2023 to March 2027). The company does not state added capacity because it makes high-mix, low-volume products to order and capex does not translate directly into capacity.

quarterly_data.signal: R&D, FY2026 (annual securities report): R&D expenses JPY 1,249 million - Test Solution JPY 646 million, Connector Solution JPY 529 million, Optical-related JPY 73 million. Test Solution developed burn-in IC sockets for high-function memory testing and IC sockets for advanced semiconductors and next-generation power semiconductors, and is developing test sockets for high-density mounting and high-speed transmission in smartphones and information-network equipment, with probe pins from high-frequency to low-cost press types. Connector Solution developed connectors for backbone optical transmission equipment, connectors for data-center equipment, board-to-board connectors and FPC connectors combined with YFLEX, plus camera-module and interface connectors for autonomous-driving equipment. Optical-related developed a compact linear variable filter (for drones and satellites) and a linear variable filter fiber module, and is improving its 1 um-band tunable lasers.
